note: Every non-human identity that calls Relay (ADR-020). Owners are accountable people. Changes need @relay/security review.

github.note: Coding sessions push branches and open pull requests through this app's one-hour installation tokens. The app is in no team named in CODEOWNERS, so its review can never satisfy code-owner review; it is on no bypass list, and branch protection restricts pushes to main, merges included, to @relay/maintainers. Team membership is declared here and must be checked against GitHub's own settings.

relay-spec-to-pr.note: The spec-to-PR helper's own app (ADR-025), so that its kill switch suspends this installation and not the coding sessions' relay-agents. Same rules as relay-agents: in no CODEOWNERS team, on no bypass list, and unable to push to main.

relay-maintenance.note: The maintenance bot's own app (ADR-053), so that its kill switch suspends this installation alone. No workflows permission, so it cannot change any file under .github/workflows/; in no CODEOWNERS team, on no bypass list, unable to approve, merge or push to main. It opens pull requests only after a person approves the proposal (relay.maintenance.proposals).
